script.speaker: maya
script.text: someone at my internship microwaved curry at 10am and i have been suffering ever since

script.speaker: liam
script.text: curry. yes. i'm in before you even ask

script.speaker: mina
script.text: curry sounds lovely :) how's the internship going, maya? last time you said your desk was right next to the printer

script.speaker: maya
script.text: still next to the printer. it's loud and it hates me

script.speaker: maya
script.text: also my manager does a head count at 1:00 sharp. i cannot be the one strolling back in at 1:20

script.speaker: liam
script.text: so no long sit-down lunch. in, eat, out. my stomach and i are ready

script.speaker: maya
script.text: and the trip fund is watching. if it's pricey, i'm eating crackers at my desk

script.speaker: mina
script.text: the coast trip! how's the saving going?

script.speaker: maya
script.text: badly. my iced tea this morning cost what a whole lunch should. downtown is robbing me

script.speaker: liam
script.text: oh, someone at work said there's a noodle stall somewhere at the night market. nobody knows where. i'm obsessed

script.speaker: liam
script.text: ok ok. but mina orders a real main this time. no plate of fries

script.speaker: liam
script.text: burger day in spring. i had a double stack. she had fries, because nothing else on the menu worked for her

script.speaker: maya
script.text: oh, like pizza day when she offered to pick the pepperoni off. absolutely not

script.speaker: mina
script.text: you two are never letting either of those go, are you

script.speaker: mina
script.text: ...okay. somewhere with a few curries i can actually order would be really nice. thank you both

script.speaker: liam
script.text: assistant, it's on you. my stomach is louder than maya's printer
